anomalies.observed: The root sheet (controller.kicad_sch) shows a single-gate logic symbol labelled '74LVC1G...' (gate shape with inputs A and B, output Y, and a GND pin) whose pins carry the labels Trio_XOR_A, Trio_XOR_B and Trio_XOR_Y; the symbol is drawn overlapping the 'Power' sheet symbol and belongs to none of the three hierarchical sheets (mcu.kicad_sch, thermocouples.kicad_sch, power.kicad_sch). On the MCU sheet the same net Trio_XOR_Y is wired to the pin of U6 labelled DELAY (TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1 heater switch), and Trio_XOR_A also appears on the MCU sheet near the ESP32 (U1) pin area.
anomalies.expected: The specified design contains no logic gate and no Trio_XOR nets. Its ICs are U1 (ESP32-C3-MINI-1), U2/U3/U4 (MAX31855KASA), U5 (TPS2121RUXR), U6 (TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1) and U8 (AP63203WU); the heater switch is driven only from the ESP32's GPIO1 via the HEATER net, and U6's configuration pins should be set per the TI datasheet, not driven from an XOR gate.

evidence.quote: Root sheet / controller.kicad_sch: gate symbol '74LVC1G...' with net labels 'Trio_XOR_A', 'Trio_XOR_B', 'Trio_XOR_Y' and 'GND'.
MCU sheet / mcu.kicad_sch: U6 pin labelled 'DELAY' wired to label 'Trio_XOR_Y'.
TL;DR: 'Drives a single heater output net through a smart high-side switch (U6, TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1) switched from the ESP32's GPIO1, using simple bang-bang control'.

anomalies.impact: An extra logic gate that is not part of the intended design is present, and its output is routed to the heater switch U6, so the heater switch (and therefore the oven heater) can behave differently from the intended simple GPIO1 bang-bang control.
